headline: Earnings tick up sequentially but stay below last year
summary_short: Unum's Q2 2026 GAAP net income was $256.9M ($1.61 diluted EPS), down 23.5% y/y but up 10.7% q/q, on revenue of $3,370M (+0.7% y/y, +0.4% q/q).
summary_long: Revenue was $3,370M, up 0.7% y/y and 0.4% q/q. EBIT margin was 11.4%, down roughly 2.7pp y/y but up 0.8pp q/q on EBIT of $382.8M. Net income was $256.9M, down 23.5% y/y, up 10.7% q/q. Diluted EPS was $1.61, down 16.1% y/y, up 14.2% q/q. Cash and equivalents fell 83.3% y/y and rose 3.4% q/q to $199.2M. Shareholders' equity was $10,809.5M, down 4.5% y/y. Weighted average diluted shares fell 8.3% y/y to 160.0M.
